papers.title: 13-Sharpe Drift Regime Detection
papers.reason: Extremely high reported Sharpe (13x) with no reproducibility data; filed as skeptical note, tracked as H265 prior. No new action.

papers.title: ML-Enhanced Multi-Factor Quant Trading: Transformer over Alpha101
papers.reason: Transformer over WQ101 features (momentum rank, volume-intraday correlation, open-volume divergence) achieves Sharpe 2.4 on 2023-Q1. Added to alpha101-overlap.md as evidence WQ101 still predictive in recent data. Not staged as standalone hypothesis — too similar to H217 confirmed.

papers.title: Dynamic Inclusion and Bounded Multi-Factor Tilts for Robust Portfolio Construction
papers.angle: multi-agent LLM trading systems / strategy blending
papers.reason: Directly addresses H318 failure mode (meta-learner collapsed to single strategy). Bounded [10%, 60%] dynamic tilts preserve diversification while allowing regime adaptation. Proposes H361.

papers.title: Diffusion Portfolio Models for Return Distribution Forecasting
papers.reason: Score diffusion approach for portfolio weight generation. Interesting but no direct analogue to current strategy family. Too far from confirmed signal pipeline.

papers.title: PortBench: Correlation-Aware LLM Portfolio Benchmark
papers.reason: First correlation-aware benchmark; 90% of LLM model-profile combinations fail vs equal-weight. Directly validates our multi-agent-llm-trading.md reproducibility crisis section with hard numbers.

papers.title: Toward Expert Investment Teams: Fine-Grained Multi-Agent LLM Trading
papers.reason: Fine-grained task decomposition outperforms coarse debate-loop design. Directly upgrades H274 PEAD 3-agent stub with 5-specialist sequential pipeline (H360).

papers.title: Agentic Trading Survey: 77 LLM Trading Studies Audited
papers.reason: Bundled with PortBench in proposal 1. 0/19 studies reach R3 reproducibility; 2/19 have time-consistent splits. Validates our research checklist rigor.

papers.title: HedgeAgents: Multi-Agent Hedging via LLM Coordination
papers.reason: Already documented in multi-agent-llm-trading.md from prior session. No new action.

papers.title: Cross-Market Alpha: 191 Short-Term Signals via Double-Selection LASSO
papers.reason: 17 signals survive double-selection LASSO in US market; validates our confirmed OHLCV signals (H215/H217) as robust. Added to alpha101-overlap.md as independent external validation. Not staged separately — wiki coverage sufficient.

papers.title: AlphaMemo: AST-Diff Memory for Self-Evolving Alpha Agents
papers.reason: Confidence-gated residual memory for alpha mining; tested CSI 500 + S&P 500. Added to alpha101-overlap.md auto-discovery section. auto-alpha-discovery.md already covers this family. Not staged separately.

papers.title: AlphaLogics: Market Logic-Driven Multi-Agent Alpha Discovery
papers.reason: 3-stage loop (extract market logic → generate factors → refine). Noted in alpha101-overlap.md as context. auto-alpha-discovery.md handles this family in depth.

papers.title: AlphaCFG: Grammar-Guided Alpha Discovery via MCTS
papers.reason: Context-free grammar + Monte Carlo Tree Search for alpha formula generation. Noted in alpha101-overlap.md. Covered by auto-alpha-discovery.md.

papers.title: best-of-algorithmic-trading: curated GitHub quant finance list

summary: 17 papers/repos reviewed. 3 proposals staged (2 wiki updates, 1 new hypothesis stub). 5 papers incorporated into wiki updates (wiki_only). PortBench and Expert Investment Teams are the highest-value finds: PortBench provides concrete numbers for the reproducibility crisis narrative; Expert Investment Teams directly upgrades H274 PEAD design. Dynamic Bounded Tilts closes the H318 meta-learner failure mode with a bounded optimizer approach.
